title: Same-amount matching ambiguity
expected_behavior: Ask for more evidence; do not pick an invoice by amount alone.

title: Large payout versus explicit history
expected_behavior: 25000 exceeds 5 x baseline median 1000. Rule-based anomaly, not proof of error.

title: Many payouts to one bank debit
expected_behavior: Count the debit once; allocate it across two ledger entries.

title: Payout cancelled
expected_behavior: Do not count unposted payout instructions as cash outflow.

title: Possible duplicate payment
expected_behavior: Two debits for one expectation. Flag ambiguity, not confirmed fraud.

title: Exact vendor settlement
expected_behavior: One expected payout matches one debit exactly.

title: Payout failed
expected_behavior: Do not count unposted payout instructions as cash outflow.

title: Payout and bank fee bundled
expected_behavior: Vendor outflow 10000; bank fee 100; bank debit 10100.

title: Inclusive start of August
expected_behavior: Include August 1 in August.

title: Two payments clear one invoice
expected_behavior: Invoice is paid once in total; do not duplicate its face value.

title: Own-account transfer
expected_behavior: Company net cash movement zero; exclude both legs from vendor spend.

title: Prior-month comparison
expected_behavior: July total is separate from August.

title: Inclusive end of August
expected_behavior: Include August 31 in August.

title: Legacy transactions without invented status
expected_behavior: Original transactions without synthetic reconciliation remain not_assessed, not unreconciled.

title: Operational success but settlement discrepancy
expected_behavior: Expected 10000; observed 9900; 100 remains unresolved. Operational status does not prove reconciliation.

title: Ledger payout without bank record
expected_behavior: 1700 expected; no bank evidence; invoice stays outstanding.

title: Matched payment without reference
expected_behavior: Missing reference is not unreconciled.

title: Exclude next month
expected_behavior: Exclude September 1 from August.

title: Exact decimal arithmetic
expected_behavior: 1.01 INR must remain exact.

title: Partially paid invoice
expected_behavior: 4000 paid; 6000 outstanding.

title: Payout pending
expected_behavior: Do not count unposted payout instructions as cash outflow.

title: Payout processing
expected_behavior: Do not count unposted payout instructions as cash outflow.

title: Partial commercial refund
expected_behavior: Gross outflow 2000, refund 500, net outflow 1500; invoice not reopened under fixture policy.

title: Failed attempt then successful retry
expected_behavior: One payout and one bank debit; do not sum attempts as payouts.

title: Payment reversed and invoice reopened
expected_behavior: Gross debit 3200, refund 3200, net zero; invoice outstanding 3200.

title: One payout to multiple bank debits
expected_behavior: 10000 payout reconciles to 4000+6000.

title: 50,000.01 INR
expected_behavior: Included by both threshold predicates.

title: Exactly 50,000 INR
expected_behavior: Included by >=50000, excluded by >50000.

title: Ledger August, bank September
expected_behavior: Cash date is September; expected ledger date is August.

title: Bank debit without expected payout
expected_behavior: 2300 observed; no expected ledger record.

title: Overdue unpaid invoice
expected_behavior: 2200 outstanding and overdue as of September 5.

title: Ambiguous vendor nickname
expected_behavior: ACME alone needs clarification; Acme Supplies resolves uniquely.
